name: Lead Recorder
description:
Lead Recorder tracks every phone click, form submission and email enquiry on a website and matches each one back to the ad, Google search or post that produced it.

This connector lets you ask about that data in plain English instead of opening a dashboard. Pull a client's numbers for the month, see which channel is producing enquiries, or spot the client sites that have gone quiet.

Three tools, all read-only:

List Sites — the client websites this account can report on.

Get Quiet Sites — sites with zero leads in the last N days. Useful if you manage a lot of client sites and want to catch a problem before the client does.

Get Monthly Report — total leads for one site in a given month, new versus returning visitors, the phone, form, email and booking split, paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top individual sources, top campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Things you can ask:

"Which of my client sites had no leads this week?"
"How did Bob's Plumbing do last month and where did the leads come from?"
"Write this month's lead report for [client] using the real numbers."

Built for marketing agencies and the businesses they work with, particularly local service businesses where the enquiry is a phone call rather than an online checkout.

The data is first-party and captured without cookies, so no consent banner and nothing rented from an ad platform.

You'll need a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lead Recorder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lead Recorder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.leadrecorder.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lead Recorder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lead Recorder provides these MCP tools: get_monthly_report, get_quiet_sites, and list_sites.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lead Recorder?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lead Recorder in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Lead Recorder MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lead Recorder requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lead Recorder is developed by Lead Recorder. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
